title: Build Sequence Optimizer
outcome: Find faster and safer implementation orders under real resource constraints
breakthrough: Projects reduce idle time and avoid expensive rework
lane: Executable planning, dependency modeling, and build sequencing

phases.name: Phase 1 - Build the Build Sequence Optimizer Core

subphases.name: 1.1 Build Sequence Optimizer Domain Model and State Plane
work: Define typed entities, capabilities, jobs, events, state transitions, and outputs required to find faster and safer implementation orders under real resource constraints, with explicit versions and validation at every boundary.

Implement an owned persistent state layer optimized for feature graphs, phases, dependencies, prototypes, execution order, scope changes, and dynamic replanning; include snapshots or event history when state changes over time.
Expose create, query, update, subscribe, and delete operations through local APIs plus an SDK that never requires private cross-runtime imports.

subphases.name: 1.2 Build Sequence Optimizer Execution Runtime
work: Build resumable workers and state machines that perform the core operation: find faster and safer implementation orders under real resource constraints.
Add cancellation, idempotency, bounded retries, timeouts, quotas, sandbox limits, and deterministic recovery from partial failure.
Create a local simulator that can replay success, malformed inputs, disconnection, overload, provider loss, and restart recovery.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Make Build Sequence Optimizer Adaptive and Usable

subphases.name: 2.1 Build Sequence Optimizer Decision and Learning Engine
work: Implement scoring, planning, prediction, search, or optimization using graph optimization, critical-path analysis, Monte Carlo simulation, constraint solving, and scenario comparison.
Create feedback signals from task outcomes and user corrections; update tunable behavior without silently changing hard safety limits.
Return confidence, alternatives, bottlenecks, and a concise machine-readable explanation for every important automated choice.

subphases.name: 2.2 Build Sequence Optimizer Interaction Surface
work: Build the primary experience in the executable roadmap canvas, dependency graph, scenario simulator, and milestone control room, including live state, controls, errors, and recovery actions.
Add a CLI and typed client library so humans, agents, games, and third-party applications can operate the capability directly.
Stream progress and intermediate artifacts in real time so long operations remain inspectable, interruptible, and steerable.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Scale Build Sequence Optimizer into a Breakthrough Product

subphases.name: 3.1 Build Sequence Optimizer Offline, Edge, and Cloud Mesh
work: Implement local-only, hybrid, and cloud execution with explicit capability discovery and graceful behavior when optional peers disappear.
Add conflict-safe synchronization, workload placement, caching, backpressure, and failover across devices or nodes where the feature benefits from distribution.
Benchmark latency, throughput, memory, energy, network transfer, and cost; make the scheduler choose the best execution mode from measured constraints.

subphases.name: 3.2 Build Sequence Optimizer Signature Breakthrough
work: Implement the differentiating behavior: Projects reduce idle time and avoid expensive rework. Ship it as an opt-in executable mode, not a mockup.
Run adversarial, load, privacy, misuse, degraded-network, and recovery tests against the novel behavior; block unsafe automatic actions.
Package the feature as an independently installable capability with a live demo, sample integration, metrics endpoint, and rollback-safe release artifact.
